recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes remaining current-build narrative surfaces that could still lead implementers to think MedicationStatement reports are limited to patients and clinicians, without reverting later accepted derived-source clarification or changing the already broader StructureDefinition semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-7168 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request from DSTU1. It objected that the MedicationStatement wording limited the record source to a report from the patient or another clinician, and the accepted resolution was to update the wording to say patient, clinician or another person.
initial_application: Historical commit e5b1777610 (#7226, 7168) applied the issue to the old MedicationStatement spreadsheet definition by replacing the patient-or-clinician wording with medication use reported by a patient, a clinician or another party. Later source refactors preserved the broader meaning in the active StructureDefinition, but current medication-domain narrative rows still repeated the old patient-or-another-clinician limitation.
additional_context: MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement are active resources in source/fhir.ini, so their introduction XML files are current build inputs. FHIR-12536 later added derived-supporting-information wording to the same MedicationStatement boundary rows; this reconciliation preserves that newer wording while loosening the reporter phrase. FHIR-7226 was applied in the same historical commit and is already represented on the combined branch by an audit commit.
reconciliation: Updated the active MedicationStatement scope and boundary narrative, plus the copied MedicationStatement rows on MedicationRequest, MedicationDispense, and MedicationAdministration, so they say the information can come from the patient, a clinician or another person while retaining the existing derived-supporting-information clause.
source_changes: source/medicationstatement/medicationstatement-introduction.xml: broadened MedicationStatement scope and boundary text from patient-only/significant-other/patient-or-clinician phrasing to patient, a clinician or another person.

source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest-introduction.xml: updated the copied MedicationStatement boundary row to patient, a clinician or another person while preserving derived supporting information.
